Hi Rachel / Susan,

Thanks — looping in Lauren for any account-level exceptions. Attached is Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (our current master DPA) and our Subprocessor_List_20261117.csv. High-level notes:

- Transfers: Redwood relies on Standard Contractual Clauses (EU SCCs) for EEA transfers and the UK IDTA for transfers to the UK. We also support contractually binding measures and can execute SCC appendices in DocuSign.
- Subprocessors: the attached CSV lists third-party subprocessors, locations, and whether they have access to plaintext customer data. We mark any subprocessors operating in the EU column 'eu_presence'.
- Logging/Audit: our master DPA includes a logging and retention section in §4.3 that meets typical healthcare minimums (audit logs retained for 12 months by default). If Optima requires 24 months, that's an operational change and we'll need an SOW amendment.
- Redlines: We can accept limited contractual redlines. Please have Optima send annotated redlines in PDF or Word. For anything that increases operational burden (longer retention, dedicated on-prem storage), we may need a pricing/ops discussion.

We prefer DocuSign for the signature flow; AdobeSign is acceptable but may slow turnaround because our legal-ops path is tuned for DocuSign templates. If Optima must use AdobeSign, we'll coordinate with legal-ops.

Attachments:
- Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf, 155KB)
- Subprocessor_List_20261117.csv (text/csv, 6KB)

Next steps suggested:
1) Optima to confirm whether the SCC + UK IDTA approach is acceptable.
2) If Optima has redlines, send them back (track-changes PDF preferred).
3) Agree on signing tool (DocuSign recommended) and we'll provision the DocuSign envelope for execution.

Laura / Lauren: can you confirm whether we can offer a 24-month audit retention as a paid opt-in?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin\Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security\Redwood Inference\marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0444
